title: ‘Trump’s exit strategy may depend on quietly lifting Iran blockade’
html:
‘Trump’s exit strategy may depend on quietly lifting Iran blockade’

US President Donald Trump will have to ease the naval blockade on Iran if he wants the war to wind down, political analyst Trita Parsi tells Al Jazeera. If not, Iran will likely keep escalating to counter the economic war the US is waging on Tehran.
summary: US President Donald Trump will have to ease the naval blockade on Iran if he wants the war to wind down, says analyst.
